data.name: Laundromat
data.detailed_description:
Laundromat is a first-person, psychological horror, 3d puzzle platformer set in a warped, liminal laundromat where gravity bends, reality folds, and detergent may hold the key to transcendence.

You awaken in an eerie laundromat—empty, humming, oddly architectured, abnormally vast. Seemingly infinite...

Hallways of washers, boxes of Mystic Mist detergent, cryptic 80s laundry advertisements, and strange contraptions fill the space. Silence echoes among the the tiled halls, yet it feels like  you're being watched.

Inspired by games like Portal, Antichamber, Lorn's Lure and Eclipsum, Laundromat blends liminal horror with nostalgic PS1 era style visuals and cosmic horror undertones to deliver a surreal yet soothing fever dream adventure filled with walking exploration and puzzle solving.

KEY FEATURES

  • Fold Reality
    Shift gravity itself, levitate objects, reveal hidden layers of the environment through altered perspectives and pierce the fabric of space through washer-gateway traveling.

  • Puzzle-Focused Gameplay
    Solve intricate, complex 3d spatial challenges by flipping gravity, walking on walls and ceilings, seeking solutions through trial and error, by exploring various perspectives from a single puzzle space.

    Use pressure plates, Mystic Mist boxes, detergent distributors, and mysterious gateways to progress and seek a way out.

  • A Story about Washing

    Piece together a rich, slow-burn, cryptic narrative that won’t be handed to you. The truth lies in the details — for those who observe, connect, and theorize. Are you truly alone? Or is something watching? What is this place anyway?

    Uncover hidden truths buried in poster ads, emergency exit signs, scattered detergent labels, warped architecture, and the haunting echoes of surreal, almost non-Euclidean spaces seemingly no with no outside.

  • Retro Aesthetic
    Embrace an indie take on ps1 and ps2 era visuals, with pixelized graphic dithering, and hints of VHS noise, CRT feel and lo-fi textures.

  • Atmosphere Over Jump Scares
    A quiet, lingering dread fueled by liminal unease and an uncanny slow-burn.

    Perfect for fans of experimental puzzle design, surreal horror, and retro aesthetics.

data.short_description: A 3D puzzle platformer set in a liminal laundromat, featuring gravity-shifting mechanics, environmental manipulation, and retro PS2-style visuals. Unravel cryptic lore and escape a slow-burn, psychological-horror fever dream where washers watch you and detergent pulses like blood.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD FX-4100
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 460 / AMD Radeon HD 6850
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: May require internet for activation
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4670 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 / AMD Radeon RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for faster loading

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains themes of psychological horror, self-harm, and death, including depictions of human remains and implications of suicide. Some visual scenes may involve stylized unsettling imagery, mild to moderate gore, and body horror elements that may not be suitable for all audiences. Additionally, the game may depict fictional acts involving the ingestion of non-edible or toxic substances, presented solely for narrative or symbolic purposes.

All depictions are entirely fictional and intended for artistic storytelling only. The developers and publishers of this game do not endorse or encourage any real-life replication of the actions portrayed in the game. They cannot be held responsible for any harm, injury, or consequences resulting from attempts to imitate or be inspired by any content shown, described, or experienced through gameplay. Viewer discretion is strongly advised.
